steps.name: ImportLatestModel
steps.label: Import Latest Model
steps.goal: This step imports the latest published model for the current asset.
steps.min_scenario: You dig through the project/library folders by hand to find the latest published version, confirm it's the right one, and bring it in — when the folders are tidy and it's where it should be.
steps.max_scenario: The published version isn't where it should be, is the wrong one, or was never published — you Slack/email whoever touched it last, wait, maybe walk the building, and the task stalls for days.

steps.name: TransferLoUVs
steps.label: Transfer UVs to Lo Mesh
steps.goal: Transfer UV maps from hi-res mesh onto the lo-res proxy so textures render on the rigged mesh.
steps.min_scenario: Hi and lo meshes are a clean matched pair — transfer is one click.
steps.max_scenario: Meshes are very different in topology; manual UV unwrap required.

steps.name: ImportAndAssembleTextures
steps.label: Import and Assemble Textures
steps.goal: This Script will import all textures and assemble materials, attaching those materials to corresponding material groups
steps.min_scenario: You dig through the project/library folders by hand to find the latest published version, confirm it's the right one, and bring it in — when the folders are tidy and it's where it should be.
steps.max_scenario: The published version isn't where it should be, is the wrong one, or was never published — you Slack/email whoever touched it last, wait, maybe walk the building, and the task stalls for days.

steps.name: SetClayShading
steps.label: Set Clay Shading
steps.goal: Strip PBR metallic/roughness maps on default_mtl materials and lock to clay values (roughness=0.65, metallic=0, specular=0) with AO baked into basecolor. Only runs on default_mtl assets — hand-crafted materials are left untouched.
steps.pass_criteria: Material has flat roughness, zero metallic, zero specular, AO multiplied into basecolor.

steps.name: CreateTurntable
steps.label: Create Turntable
steps.goal: THis script will create the turntable for the model, and add the model to the turntable so that the artist can easily submit a render.
steps.min_scenario: You hand-build the structure to the studio's convention — when the convention is clear and the inputs are present.
steps.max_scenario: The convention is undocumented or inconsistent across artists; you rebuild and reconcile it by hand.

steps.name: CreateHdriRig
steps.label: Create HDRI Rig
steps.goal: This will build the default turntable light rig for this asset.
steps.min_scenario: You hand-build the structure to the studio's convention — when the convention is clear and the inputs are present.
steps.max_scenario: The convention is undocumented or inconsistent across artists; you rebuild and reconcile it by hand.

steps.name: SetRenderSettings
steps.label: Set Render Settings
steps.goal: Set Cycles render settings, output path, and camera for the ldv turntable render.
steps.min_scenario: Settings applied in seconds.
steps.max_scenario: Camera or scene missing — requires manual setup.

steps.name: RenderTurntable
steps.label: Render Turntable
steps.goal: Render the ALC_TT_cam turntable as an EXR sequence.
steps.min_scenario: Fast GPU — done in minutes.
steps.max_scenario: CPU only — hours for a full 120-frame Cycles render.

steps.name: ProcessRenders
steps.label: Process Renders
steps.goal: Convert the EXR sequence to a review mp4.
steps.min_scenario: OIIO encode done in seconds.
steps.max_scenario: Long sequence — a few minutes.

steps.name: CleanTurntable
steps.label: Clean Turntable
steps.goal:
Remove the turntable rig before publishing the ldv scene.

The published .blend should contain only the rigged/textured asset and
the HDRI light rig — no camera animation scaffold.

steps.name: OrganizeLdvScene
steps.label: Organize LDV Scene
steps.goal:
Prepare the ldv scene for linking into previs/shot scenes.

1. Collects all top-level scene objects into a named collection
   ``{child}_ldv`` (e.g. ``ancientForestRuins_ldv``) so the published
   .blend has a single, identifiable linkable collection — not the
   anonymous ``Collection`` root.
2. Removes any empty ``turntable`` collection shell left by CleanTurntable.

steps.name: ExportMaterialLibrary
steps.label: Export Material Library
steps.goal: Write a materials-only .blend sidecar alongside the ldv publish so previs scenes can link character shaders without re-linking the full rig.
steps.pass_criteria: materials.blend sidecar written; materials_blend stamped on version MSD.

steps.name: SaveLdvScene
steps.label: Save LDV Scene to Render
steps.goal:
Save the lookdev .blend into the version render dir to stage for publish.

The render-tree copy is what ``Publish`` picks up and copies to
publish/latest — it should contain the textured, cleaned asset scene
(no turntable rig) so previs scenes can link materials from it.

steps.name: PublishLdv
steps.label: Publish LDV
steps.goal: Publish the ldv scene: copy to next major + publish/latest.

steps.name: CreateFolders
steps.label: Create Folders
steps.goal: Create a working folder in compliance with the studio's folder structure.
steps.end_result: Every time someone starts a task, the correct structure is created instantly - consistent and visible to the entire production.
steps.min_scenario: You hand-build the structure to the studio's convention — when the convention is clear and the inputs are present.

steps.end_result: Every time someone starts a task they start with a production tested default file.

steps.name: CheckForReviewFiles
steps.label: Check For Review Files
steps.goal:
Locate the render image sequence to review (prefers ``playblast``) and
stash its printf pattern + frame range in shared_data for downstream steps.
steps.min_scenario: You set up the camera/settings and capture the media by hand, then drop it where reviewers look — when it works first try.
steps.max_scenario: Settings are off or reviewers can't find it; you re-capture and re-share, and review slips.

steps.name: CheckForExistingReview
steps.label: Check For Existing Review
steps.goal:
Clear any stale preview so this run regenerates clean media, and note
whether a tracker Version already exists for this context.
steps.min_scenario: You set up the camera/settings and capture the media by hand, then drop it where reviewers look — when it works first try.
steps.max_scenario: Settings are off or reviewers can't find it; you re-capture and re-share, and review slips.

steps.name: AddDescription
steps.label: Add Description
steps.goal:
Ensure a version description is set.

Headless/farm-safe: the description comes from shared_data (set by the
trigger / UI before the recipe runs); we don't pop a dialog here. Falls
back to a sensible default so the review never blocks.

The standard intermediate (handles EXR → predictable HD PNG) downstream
media + the in-app player consume. Delegates to ``services/media/video``.

Create a review Version in the active tracker (ShotGrid/…) via the
backend-agnostic tracking layer. Ensures project/asset/task context first.
Clean no-op when no tracker is configured.

Generate version + task thumbnails from the review proxies.

Delegates to ``services/media/video.thumbnail`` (middle frame).

steps.goal:
Attach the review mp4 to the tracker Version (uploads + adds to today's

steps.name: MarkForReview
steps.label: Mark for Review
steps.goal: mark the mp4 file we've created in this task for review within Alchemy.
steps.pass_criteria: new tab is opened showing the review in the media link.

steps.name: AddToDailiesPlaylist
steps.label: Add To Dailies Playlist

steps.fail_criteria: No media added to playlist, or playlist not created
